T: Welcome to the family. Dinner's on.
D: The Byrnes family travel to Florida to meet the Focker parents before the wedding.
P: Serve the mains when the two families sit down together.
S: Creamy ham croquetas crumbed and fried, with lime garlic mayo

Crisp crumbed Cuban croquettes with a creamy ham béchamel centre, fried golden and served with a garlicky lime aioli. Melt 60g butter, stir in 80g plain flour for 2 minutes, then slowly whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Stir in 200g finely chopped leg ham, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Spread on a tray, cover and chill 3 hours. Shape into 16 small logs, roll in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 120g breadcrumbs. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and lime juice.
Crisp fritters of chopped prawn, capsicum and spring onion

Crisp Florida-style fritters packed with chopped prawns, capsicum and spring onion, served with a tangy key lime and chilli dipping sauce. Chop 400g peeled green prawns. Mix 150g self-raising flour, 1 egg, 150ml soda water, 1/2 diced red capsicum, 2 sliced spring onions, 1/2 tsp Cajun seasoning and salt into a thick batter, then fold in the prawns. Drop heaped tablespoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes, turning, until golden. Drain. For the sauce, mix 100g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce and the juice of 2 limes.
M: Wall of Gaylord mojo roast pork
Citrus garlic roast pork shoulder with black beans and fried banana

Pork shoulder marinated in garlic, orange, lime and cumin, slow-roasted until tender, with black beans, rice and fried sweet plantain or banana. Blitz 8 garlic cloves, the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp dried oregano, 60ml olive oil and salt. Rub over a 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder and marinate overnight. Roast covered at 160C for 3 hours, then uncovered at 200C for 30 minutes. Fry 1 onion and 1 capsicum, add 2 drained tins black beans and 1 tsp cumin and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with 300g rice and 2 sliced bananas fried in butter.
W: Jinx and Moses key lime pie
Tart lime custard in a biscuit crust

A sharp, creamy lime custard set in a crunchy biscuit base, topped with whipped cream and fresh lime zest. Crush 200g plain sweet biscuits and mix with 80g melted butter. Press into a 23cm pie dish and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Whisk 4 egg yolks with a 395g tin condensed milk, then whisk in 150ml lime juice and the zest of 2 limes. Pour into the base and bake at 160C for 15 minutes until just set. Cool, then chill 3 hours. Top with 300ml whipped cream and more lime zest.
K: White rum, muddled mint and lime, topped with soda

White rum muddled with fresh mint, lime and sugar, topped with soda over crushed ice. Leave out the rum for a virgin mojito. In each of 4 tall glasses, muddle 8 mint leaves with half a lime cut into wedges and 2 tsp caster sugar until the sugar dissolves. Fill with crushed ice. Pour 45ml white rum into each, then top with 120ml soda water. Stir from the bottom with a long spoon to pull the mint up through the ice. Garnish with a big mint sprig and a lime wheel.

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in some of the flour for a couple of minutes, then slowly whisk in the milk until very thick.
Stir in the ham, nutmeg and pepper. Spread on a tray, cover and chill.
Shape into small logs, roll in the remaining flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic and a squeeze of lime juice and serve for dipping.

veg.n: Coconut Grove corn and zucchini fritters

steps.text: Squeeze the grated zucchini hard in a clean tea towel to get rid of the water.
Mix the flour, egg, soda water, capsicum, spring onions, Cajun seasoning and salt into a thick batter, then fold in the corn and zucchini.
Drop heaped tablespoons into the oil at 180C and fry, turning, until golden. Drain.
Mix the mayonnaise, sweet chilli sauce and lime juice for the sauce.

dishes.n: Wall of Gaylord mojo roast pork

steps.text: Blitz the garlic, orange and lime juice, two teaspoons of the cumin, oregano, oil and salt. Rub over the pork.
Marinate overnight in the fridge. This step is the day before.
Roast covered at 160C, then uncovered at 200C.
Fry the onion and capsicum, add the beans and remaining cumin and simmer.
Cook the rice. Fry the banana slices in the butter.
Rest and shred the pork and serve with beans, rice and bananas.

veg.n: Wall of Gaylord mojo roast cauliflower
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day in the fridge

steps.text: Blitz the garlic, orange and lime juice, two teaspoons of the cumin, the oregano, oil and salt. Sit the cauliflowers in a roasting dish and spoon the mojo over and into the florets.
Marinate in the fridge for 2 hours.
Roast covered at 200C for 40 minutes, then uncovered for 30 minutes, basting with the juices, until charred and tender.
Fry the onion and capsicum, add the beans and remaining cumin and simmer.
Cook the rice. Fry the banana slices in the butter.
Cut the cauliflowers into thick wedges, spoon over the pan juices and serve with the beans, rice and bananas.

Cool, then chill.
Top with whipped cream and more lime zest.
